mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) over the past year signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in improving labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDPC1 (GDP) above 11800 signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where GDPC1 > 11800 are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 t-test), or the signal occurs without a positive return.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and HOUST rising simultaneously does not occur in robust demand periods, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (supply index) above 110.3 signals strong supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 110.3 in the trigger period, or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% signals monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE over the past 6 months indicates improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline below its 6-month low in the past year, or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (GDP) and INDPRO (supply) indicates robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO rising simultaneously does not occur in expanding economy periods, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 5.0% signals a strong labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 5.0% in the trigger period, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 t-test).
